perplexity.description:
Northern Soul All Nighter is a 2016 compilation album released by Not Now Music, featuring a curated selection of tracks by various artists associated with the Northern Soul movement. The album showcases the genre’s signature blend of upbeat, danceable rhythms, emotive vocals, and energetic instrumentation, drawing from Funk, Soul, and Blues traditions. Tracks such as Al Wilson’s “The Snake,” Carla Thomas’s “Dance With Me,” and Sam Cooke’s “Sugar Dumpling” highlight the compilation’s focus on rare and classic recordings that defined the Northern Soul scene, making it a vibrant snapshot of the genre’s enduring appeal.

As a compilation rather than a studio album by a single artist, Northern Soul All Nighter does not fit into a traditional discography but serves as a representative collection for fans and newcomers alike. Not Now Music is known for its high-quality reissues and themed compilations, and this release continues that tradition with a gatefold 2LP vinyl set that emphasizes both sound quality and historical context. The album was well-received for its track selection and presentation, appealing to collectors and enthusiasts of vintage soul music, though it did not achieve mainstream commercial success. Its release in 2016 reaffirmed the ongoing interest in Northern Soul and its influence on contemporary Funk, Soul, and Pop music.
